app.title: Oblireach Support
notice.title: Before you share your code
notice.body: Only give your ID and code to someone you trust and whom you contacted yourself.
notice.scam: Nobody legitimate (a bank, Microsoft, the police, a delivery company...) calls you out of the blue to take control of your computer. If an unexpected caller asked you to download this program, hang up.
main.hint: Read both to the person helping you. The code works only once and changes every 10 minutes.
status.waiting: Waiting for your helper to connect
status.upgrade: This version is no longer accepted by the server. Please download the latest version.
status.refusedByServer: The server refused the connection. Retrying in {{seconds}} s
status.locked: Someone entered wrong codes: a new ID was created for you.
status.failed: A connection attempt with a wrong code failed: a new code was drawn.
status.refused: Request refused. A new code was drawn.
status.timedOut: No answer in time: the request was refused. A new code was drawn.
status.withdrawn: The request was cancelled. A new code was drawn.
status.setupFailed: The connection could not be established. A new code was drawn.
approve.title: Remote assistance request
approve.wants: wants to connect to this computer
approve.selfDeclared: Name given by the helper (not verified)
approve.noAccount: No account verified by the server
approve.sasHint: Your helper sees the same code. Ask them to read it to you: if it does not match, refuse.
approve.allowControl: Control of the mouse and keyboard
session.title: Session in progress
session.control: can see and control your screen
session.hotkey: You can also press Ctrl+Alt+F12 at any time to end the session.
ended.title: Session ended
ended.error: The session stopped because of an error.
error.window: The window could not be created: {{error}}
lang.title: Language
lang.hint: Choose the language of this window.
chat.title: Chat with {{name}}
chat.empty: Messages from {{name}} will appear here. You can reply below.
chat.private: Messages are not saved: they disappear when the session ends.
chat.placeholder: Type a message, then press Enter
report.title: Report this helper
report.intro: Your report goes to the administrators of the server {{name}}, with the reference of this session. Use it if the person who connected deceived you or abused your trust.
report.sent.title: Report sent
report.sent.body: Thank you. The administrators of the server will look into it.
report.advice.title: Protect yourself
report.advice: If you gave payment details, card numbers or passwords, contact your bank now and change your passwords. You can also report the scam to the police.
report.done: Report sent to the administrators of the server.
report.err.unreachable: The report could not be sent: the server cannot be reached. Please try again.
report.err.rateLimited: Too many reports were sent from this connection. Please try again in a few minutes.
report.err.refused: The server refused the report: the session is too old, or it was already reported.
report.err.unavailable: This session can no longer be reported.
